headline: A $0.10B SRF print puts dollar funding on watch, but the calendar—not overnight pricing—is carrying the strain call
dek: Standing Repo Facility acceptance reached $0.10B, an extreme move from a near-zero base but not a large flow. Seiche’s board reads EROSION as dated reserve pressure approaches; SOFR still signals abundant overnight cash.

newsworthiness.rule: a full story needs a fresh measured change and at least 55 points; levels, persistence and quiet tapes remain labelled briefs or watch notes

limitations: The composite is a Seiche derivation, not an observed market price.
Source publication time is not yet collected uniformly; event, desk-knowledge and publication clocks remain separate.
Related Palimpsest readings are context-only and never enter the composite or a model feature.

review_notes: Recast the SRF print as a monitoring signal rather than evidence of broad facility demand.
Made the calendar-to-reserve-distribution-to-pricing mechanism explicit and conditional.
Strengthened the counter-case around SOFR, limited SRF use and calm market pricing.
Specified an observable falsification test and retained scenario, model and source-time limits.
Removed the unsupported reserve-gap figure while retaining the documented below-kink finding and fit limitation.
Preserved the calendar-to-reserves-to-pricing mechanism, counter-case, observable test, source links and research boundary.
